name: Europa Jūrtaka E9, Latvia
description_md:
Europa Jurtaka E9 in Latvia is a waymarked hiking route spanning 567.7 km within the international waymarked hiking network. The trail involves 1291 m of ascent and 1284 m of descent, requiring about 145 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

The route is signposted as E9 and carries a hard difficulty rating derived from its distance and ascent. Walkers can access nearby places since the trail passes within 100 m of Old Riga, Riga, and the Museum of the history of Riga and navigation.
